stage0087_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Are you ready, you lot!
　Let's go beat that $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ down already!」

stage0087_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$葵$$
「Um... getting fired up is fine, but...」

stage0087_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$くらら$$
「Do you... know something about the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$?」

stage0087_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$カグラ$$
「So he's basically some full-of-himself
　bastard and our enemy, right?
　Then I'll just knock him flat, is all!」

stage0087_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$キタン$$
「Now there's a guy with some real fire in him」

stage0087_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ギミー$$
「Yeah! He seems like he'll be reliable!」

stage0087_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Since he's such a wild guy, I was thinking
　of making him a Team D reserve,
　but this one suits the Dai-Gurren Brigade more」

stage0087_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ダリー$$
「$$朔哉$$...!
　Please don't think the Dai-Gurren Brigade
　is just about charging in」

stage0087_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Well, some of our members can't help
　giving that impression, I guess」

stage0087_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$カグラ$$
「A fight's basically about charging in, right?
　And if there's someone you can't drop there,
　you finish it with the next hit」

stage0087_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Please give him a refresher on
　the basics of combat before the
　decisive battle with the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$」

stage0087_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I'm counting on you, $$ゼシカ$$」

stage0087_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Can't be helped, I guess.
　C'mon... let's go to the simulator, $$カグラ$$」

stage0087_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Do I even need that at this point?」

stage0087_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$n
「Looks like a wild beast really does
　need to be tamed by force」

stage0087_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Get ready, $$カグラ$$.
　$n's going to be your training partner」

stage0087_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$n
「My $$ハンター$$ blood's stirring for the first time in a while」

stage0087_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Bring it on.
　I'll eat you alive instead」

stage0087_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Now now, don't use such dangerous words
　on a teammate」

stage0087_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$カグラ$$
「While we're at it!
　You two come too!」

stage0087_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$カグラ$$
「...Tell me about $$ジン$$.
　What he saw and felt out there in Vega」

stage0087_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$スズネ$$
「At first I was worried, $$カグラ$$...
　but it looks like you'll manage somehow」

stage0087_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「It's thanks to $$ゼシカ$$ acting as the go-between」

stage0087_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$アルト$$
（More like a trainer than a go-between）

stage0087_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$宗介$$
「How are $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$ doing?」

stage0087_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$アルト$$
「Those two are in their room.
　Given the situation, they'll be
　coming along with $c as is」

stage0087_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$マオ$$
「Is that going to be all right?」

stage0087_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$アルト$$
「This kind of thing's happened before too,
　so they're both okay with it」

stage0087_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Nah, that's not it.
　I'm talking about $$ランカ$$-chan」

stage0087_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$マオ$$
「Guess it's not that you hadn't noticed」

stage0087_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Seems like that girl's been
　kind of down since the fight at Altair」

stage0087_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$宗介$$
「Is she afraid of $$ミカゲ$$'s hatred?」

stage0087_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$マオ$$
「He's already been defeated.
　No need to worry about that」

stage0087_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$$アルト$$... caring about the other person
　matters too, but right now, focus on
　what's in front of you」

stage0087_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「The next battle's sure to be a tough one too」

stage0087_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't forget, that you coming back
　alive matters more to those kids
　than anything else」

stage0087_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$スズネ$$
「...What happened to $$シュレード$$ was awful,
　but that's why I want all of us to return
　to Jindai High without losing anyone else」

stage0087_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「So, $$アルト$$... let's do our best」

stage0087_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$マオ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$'s really grown up, hasn't she.
　She's a full-fledged teacher now」

stage0087_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Well then, Miss... how about me...」

stage0087_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「No private lessons allowed.
　A teacher should be fair to every student」

stage0087_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Aww, guess she saw right through me」

stage0087_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$宗介$$
「If you repeat the same tactic
　enough times, this is the natural result」

stage0087_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$マオ$$
「But isn't there a kid who seriously
　needs some individual care?」

stage0087_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That one, I've left to $$タケル$$ and $$ワッ太$$」

stage0087_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$正太郎$$...
　For the next battle... you stay and
　guard $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$」

stage0087_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「But... $$グーラ$$'s not in the mood
　to listen to what we've got to say」

stage0087_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I'll settle things with $$グーラ$$ myself」

stage0087_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$タケル$$
「There's no need for that.
　I'll be the one to fight him」

stage0087_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$正太郎$$
「...$$グーラ$$ is an enemy targeting Earth」

stage0087_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Precisely because $$グーラ$$'s my friend,
　if he's going to do something wrong,
　I'll be the one to stop him」

stage0087_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$正太郎$$
「The time I spent with $$グーラ$$ was short.
　But I... I can't think of $$グーラ$$
　as a stranger」

stage0087_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Just as $$グーラ$$ became Earth's invasion
　commander as the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s son,
　I too was entrusted with $$鉄人$$ by my father...」

stage0087_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$正太郎$$
「That's why I...
　I want to stop $$グーラ$$...」

stage0087_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I fight against evil...
　That's my mission, entrusted
　with $$鉄人$$」

stage0087_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$正太郎$$
「If I forgive evil just because
　it's my friend, I'd have to
　give up $$鉄人$$」

stage0087_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$タケル$$
「You've already... made up your mind」

stage0087_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$正太郎$$
（$$グーラ$$...
　If you won't change your mind,
　I'll defeat you...）

stage0087_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
???
「A world of darkness...
　A place filled with the power of shadow」

stage0087_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
???
「The stellar energy absorbed
　into $$鉄人$$ gained $$正太郎$$'s
　pure will and gave birth to power」

stage0087_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
???
「It annihilated the black hole,
　and destroyed the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$」

stage0087_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
???
「Having used up all its power,
　$$鉄人$$ fell into this world」

stage0087_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$マーグ#pilot$$
「Mars...
　Use your power to guide $$鉄人$$
　to the world of light」

stage0087_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$タケル$$
「Brother...!
　I knew it, it really is you, Brother!」

stage0087_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$マーグ#pilot$$
「Hurry, Mars.
　You and I together can bridge
　darkness and light」

stage0087_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$マーグ#pilot$$
「That's our fate...
　The mission of us both, born
　into darkness and light」

stage0087_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$タケル$$
「Brother...!
　I'll give it a try!」

stage0087_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$マーグ#pilot$$
「Fight, Mars...
　My other half, who holds the light...」

stage0087_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「It's exactly when you're in a mood
　like that, that you oughta drink.
　To forget all the crap you hate」

stage0087_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「Why I was drawn to you」

stage0087_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「A man and a woman don't need
　a reason, do they?」

stage0087_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「You're the same as me...
　There's no place for you here」

stage0087_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「A doll, placed in a world
　someone built...
　I... I came to know that...」

stage0087_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「No... I'd known it for a
　long time now. But I thought
　I could live on, looking away from it」

stage0087_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「But he wouldn't accept that」

stage0087_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「$$ロジャー・スミス$$, huh...」

stage0087_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「He's a reckless guy too.
　If he'd just lived on without his memories,
　he'd have been free of both pain and sorrow...」

stage0087_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「In you, choosing to live that way,
　I felt something the same as myself...」

stage0087_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「But... I think I'm at my limit...」

stage0087_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「I... I've read it...
　The final chapter of '$$メトロポリス$$'...」

stage0087_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「I want to forget everything...
　Go back to when I knew nothing...」

stage0087_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「$$エンジェル$$...
　A messenger of god... huh...」

stage0087_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「...Damn...
　The booze is gonna taste bad again...」

stage0087_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My apologies!
　An emergency's come up, so today
　D-Trader will run on the automatic system!」

stage0087_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The celebration for the ace pilot
　will also be carried over to next time!」

stage0087_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even I have to say, this is bad...!
　This is an unexpected situation
　even for me! Well then, excuse me!」
